data.name: Alejandro
data.gender_notes: Alejandro is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old Spanish name Alessandro, derived from the Hebrew name Eliyahu (Elijah), meaning 'My God is Jehovah'. Alejandro is the Spanish variation of the Hebrew name, and it signifies 'Defender of mankind'. In the Bible, Elijah was a prophet who confronted King Ahab and stood up against idolatry, performing many miracles. Alejandro is a strong and powerful name, representing courage and leadership.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage and protection, inspired by the biblical prophet Elijah.
data.etymology: Alejandro belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Defender of mankind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alejandro total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_latin.name: Alejandro
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Alejandro originem habet in lingua Graeca, sed per Latinam linguam diffusum est. Compositum est ex 'alex', quod significat defensor, et 'andros', quod significat vir fortis. In traditione Christiana, nomen Alejandro habet connotationes virtutis et protectionis, quae sunt aspectus fundamentales fidei Christianae.
